7096653.baseName: Habitat 5ft Fibre Optic Christmas Tree - White
7096653.variantName: Habitat 5ft Fibre Optic Christmas Tree - White
7096653.sourceDescription: Bring the magic of a white Christmas into your home with this 5ft pre-lit fibre optic tree. You're getting 180 tips of flat-needled branches in crisp white PVC, plus 24 multicoloured fibre optic lights already built in. No tangled wires, no bulb-hunting, just slot the hinged pieces together, lower the branches and plug it in. The tree sits on a sturdy plastic stand that's included in the box, giving you everything you need to transform your space in minutes. The fibre optic lights change colour and twinkle gently, creating a soft, shifting glow that feels both modern and festive. There's plenty of room to add your own decorations if you want to layer on tinsel, baubles or garlands. Once you've set it up, a little tweaking and teasing of the branches will give it that full, lush look. It's suitable for indoor use and built to last, so you can pack it away and bring it back year after year. . n3cpwsrr.baseName: Walplus 150 LED Lamp Lights Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
n3cpwsrr.variantName: Walplus 150 LED Lamp Lights Hinged Artificial Christmas Tree - White - 150 cm
n3cpwsrr.sourceDescription: This Artificial Hinged Christmas Tree redefines seasonal décor with its realistic appearance and innovative design, transforming any living space into a festive haven. Its modern style and lifelike leaf arrangement make it a captivating centerpiece for homes during the holiday season while maintaining a sleek, minimal aesthetic. Crafted with simplicity and functionality in mind, this tree is easily assembled, blending seamlessly into various décor styles and imbuing environments with the warmth and joy synonymous with Christmas. Materials: Crafted from high-grade PVC and steel, offering durability and a realistic look. The materials ensure the tree withstands multiple seasons while retaining its visual appeal. This blend not only adds to the longevity but also enhances the visual aesthetics of the tree, making it look lush and full. Included Components: Equipped with decorative string lights that seamlessly adorn the tree, providing a warm white glow that enhances its natural look. Coupled with a reliable metal stand that ensures the tree stays upright and stable throughout the festive season. Features /Function /Design: The hinged construction allows for quick setup and disassembly, saving both time and effort. The lifelike tips give it a fresh, full appearance, while the foldable stand provides convenience for storage and stability in use. Recommended Uses: Perfect for living rooms, this tree can complement a variety of home decors, enhancing the holiday spirit. It transforms spaces with its decorative lights and creates a warm, inviting atmosphere. Care &Maintenance: Assemble according to the manufacturer's instructions for optimal stability. Ensure the LED lights are handled with care to maintain their function and longevity. Product Specifications Colour: White Material: PVC and steel Tree height: 150 cm Bottom diameter: 104 cm Stand size: 35 cm Hinged construction for set up, Lifelike Tips, Foldable Stand Number of PVC tips: 519 Number of baubles: 61 Lights type: Decorative string lights Lights color: Warm white Lights length: 3000 cm Number of LEDs: 150 LED flash modes: 8 Power source: USB Voltage: 5 V Cable length: 200 cm Indoor use only Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Christmastree 1 x Stand 1 x LED stringlight 1 x Peak 20 x 3 cm ball 21 x 4 cm ball 20 x 6 cm ball This product is powered by DC 5V, but the certified 5V USB power source is not included. Higher voltage may cause overheating to occur and may result in damage to the device and the potential risk of overheating and fiire. • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd

gmwywcxw.variantName: Neo 50cm Christmas Wreath with Red Berries Baubles and Pine Cones
gmwywcxw.sourceDescription: Bring traditional festive charm to your home with this luxurious Christmas wreath, beautifully arranged with lush green artificial foliage, vibrant red berries, natural-look pine cones, rich green leaves and elegant red and dark baubles. The full, layered design creates an eye-catching seasonal display that adds instant warmth and colour to your Christmas décor. Ideal for displaying on front doors, internal doors, fireplaces, walls or as a festive table centrepiece, this decorative wreath can be enjoyed throughout the Christmas season. Its classic combination of evergreen foliage, berries and baubles complements traditional, rustic and contemporary festive interiors, while the artificial construction means you can store it away and reuse it year after year. •Beautiful Festive Design: Decorated with realistic evergreen foliage, bright red berries, pine cones, leafy accents and contrasting Christmas baubles for a rich, traditional seasonal appearance. •Full and Layered Appearance: Generously arranged branches and decorations create an attractive, luxurious-looking wreath that makes a striking addition to your Christmas decorations. •Versatile Christmas Decoration: Perfect for styling on front doors, internal doors, walls and above fireplaces, or use it as an eye-catching Christmas table centrepiece. •Classic Christmas Colours: Rich greens, festive reds and natural pine cone details create a timeless look that coordinates beautifully with a wide variety of Christmas decorating themes. •Reusable Seasonal Décor: Made with artificial foliage and decorative elements, allowing the wreath to be carefully stored after Christmas and brought out again for future festive seasons. •H 50 x W 50 x D 9.3cm This product is intended for decorative purposes only and is not a toy. Keep out of reach of young children and pets. Small or detachable decorative components, including berries, baubles, pine cones, leaves and foliage, may present a choking hazard. Keep away from naked flames, candles, fireplaces, heaters and other heat or ignition sources. Ensure the wreath is securely attached when displayed on doors, walls or other elevated surfaces to prevent it from falling. Do not place directly above or close to an active fireplace. Regularly inspect for loose, damaged or detached components and discontinue use if damaged. Protect from prolonged exposure to adverse weather conditions. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use. Neo Direct Ltd. Butterley Street, Leeds, LS10 1AW

xqh3603e.sourceDescription: Wish your garden had a Christmas wow factor? The Outsunny outdoor Christmas inflatable creates a festive holiday display. Standing 243 cm tall, this adorable Santa holds a Christmas tree and waves to welcome guests. Built-in LEDs add a cosy glow, brightening winter nights with holiday charm. ● Giant inflatable christmas decoration stands 243 cm tall in a charming standing pose holding a Christmas tree and waving ● Bright integrated LED light effects enhance nighttime visibility to maximise outdoor cheer ● Integrated blower system enables rapid inflation in about 1 minute ● Safe low-voltage and standard UK BS plug for reliable operation. Long power cord for flexible placement ● Long-lasting 210T polyester fabric and an IP44 rating help support outdoor use ● Includes four ground stakes, two tether ropes and a sandbag to help keep the christmas garden decoration secure outdoors ● Includes a storage bag for convenient organization ● A wonderful holiday gift for friends and family, suitable for gardens, lawns and party spaces ● Colour: Red, Green, White, Black ● Type: Inflatable Christmas Santa Holding a Christmas Tree ● Material: 210T Polyester Cloth ● Overall Dimensions: 150L x 78W x 243H cm ● Power Cable Length: 1.9 m ● Sandbag Weight: 0.2 kg ● LED Light Count: 9 (3 Light Modules) ● LED Light Power: 0.5W each ● Fan: 12V / 0.8A ● Input Voltage: 220-240V, 50/60Hz ● Output Voltage: 12V / 1A ● Item Label: 84J-327V70RD ● NOTE: Keep plug in while in use and unplugging after eight hours to help prolong the life of the motor Warning: this product is not a toy. Keep away from children unless under adult supervision. Keep away from open flames and heat sources. If powered, disconnect before cleaning or storage and do not use if damaged. Keep batteries away from children and dispose of used batteries safely. MH Star UK Ltd, 1 Northampton Cross Logistics Park, Northampton Cross Road, Northampton, NN4 9FH, United Kingdom
